context: The solution must use the specify-cli package to test AI agent selection during project initialization. Evaluation focuses on correct use of the CLI's agent-related options and reading the resulting configuration. Internal specify-cli implementation details are not assessed.

checklist.name: CLI agent option
checklist.description: Passes the `--agent` option (e.g. `--agent claude`, `--agent copilot`, `--agent gemini`) to the specify CLI during initialization.

checklist.name: Named agents tested
checklist.description: Exercises at least three of the named agents: `claude`, `copilot`, and `gemini`, each in a separate invocation.

checklist.name: Generic agent with commands-dir
checklist.description: Invokes the CLI with `--agent generic` together with the `--commands-dir` option pointing to a custom directory, and verifies that path is stored in the generated config.

checklist.name: Config verification
checklist.description: Reads the generated project configuration file and asserts that the agent value matches the one supplied on the CLI.
